Welcome Benefits

    - 10 Elite Night Credits*
    - Silver Elite Status

  • Cardholders onboarded on or after 1st October 2026 would receive the below mentioned benefits* on levy of card fee.
    - 1 Free Night Award (valued at 15,000 Marriott Bonvoy Points)
    - 10 Elite Night Credits*
    - Silver Elite Status

Marriott Bonvoy Reward Points Benefit / Reward Benefits

  • Earn 8 Marriott Bonvoy Points per Rs. 150 spent at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy*

  • - Earn 4 Marriott Bonvoy Points per Rs. 150 spent on Travel, Dining & Entertainment*

  • - Earn 2 Marriott Bonvoy® Points per Rs. 150 spent on all other applicable purchases*

Anniversary Special Offer 2026

  • From 01st October 2026 through 30th November 2026 (the “Offer Period”), Primary Marriott Bonvoy HDFC Bank Cardmembers are eligible for either of the following:

    - 15,000 Marriott Bonvoy points on achieving an Eligible Spend milestone of Rs.1,50,000 (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand only) within the Offer Period

    or

    - 30,000 Marriott Bonvoy points on achieving an Eligible Spend milestone of Rs.2,50,000 (Rupees Two Lakh Fifty Thousand only) within the Offer Period.

    Key Offer Terms

    - This offer will strictly be enrollment-based.
    - Cardholders can enroll for this offer until 10th November 2026
    - Only primary cardholders can enroll for this offer
    - For customers enrolling before or on 1st October 2026 for the offer, eligible spends from 01st October 2026 to 30th November 2026 will be taken into consideration.
    - For customers enrolling after 1st October 2026 for the offer, only eligible spends from such respective enrolment date to 30th November 2026 will be taken into consideration.
    - Customers will be notified via SMS or email on successful registration maximum within 5 working days

Credit Card Management & Controls

Choose from our range of servicing options

  1. Netbanking

  2. HDFC Bank App

  3. MyCards

  4. PayZapp

  5. WhatsApp Banking

  6. IVR

NetBanking

To enable card controls through NetBanking:

  1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking using your Customer ID.
  2. Go to Cards > Select Card > Manage Card > Manage Domestic & International Limits.
  3. View your current domestic and international usage limits.
  4. Enable/disable Online, Contactless, and International usage.
  5. Click Update, enter the OTP sent to your registered mobile number, and click Continue.
  6. Your card controls will be updated instantly.

Login Now

HDFC Bank App

To enable card controls through the HDFC Bank App:

  1. Log in and go to Cards.
  2. Select your Credit Card and tap Manage Limits.
  3. Enable/disable Online, Contactless, and International transactions, or update transaction limits.
  4. Tap Update and enter your MPIN. Your changes will be applied instantly.
  5. For advanced card management, visit https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/.

 

MyCards

To enable card controls through MyCards:
 

  1. Visit https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in/.
  2. Log in using your registered mobile number and OTP. First-time users must enter the last four digits of their card.
  3. Open the Card Control tab.
  4. Enable/disable Online, Contactless, and International transactions, or update usage limits.
  5. Confirm your changes. They will be applied instantly.
     
 
MyCard

PayZapp

To enable card controls through PayZapp:
 

  1. Log in and go to MyCards > Go to MyCards.
  2. Sign in using your registered mobile number and OTP. First-time users must enter the last four digits of their Credit Card.
  3. Open the Card Control tab.
  4. Enable/disable Online, Contactless, and International transactions, or update usage limits.
  5. Confirm your changes. They will be applied instantly.

 

Know More

WhatsApp Banking

To enable card controls through WhatsApp Banking:
 

  1. Save HDFC Bank's official WhatsApp number 7070022222.
  2. Send "Credit Card".
  3. Select Manage My Card, then choose Domestic / International / Enhance Limits.
  4. Select the transaction type, set the preferred limit, and verify using the OTP sent to your registered mobile number.
  5. Enter the last four digits of your Credit Card.
  6. Your updated transaction status will be displayed.
     
Chat Banking Know More

IVR

To enable or modify your HDFC Bank Credit Card controls and transaction limits, you can contact HDFC Bank's toll-free numbers:

  1. Toll-free numbers: 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (available from 8 am to 8 pm)

Contactless Payment 

  • The HDFC Bank Marriott Bonvoy Credit Card is enabled for contactless payments for fast and secure payments. 
  • Contactless payments for Diners cards will be accepted only in HDFC Bank Point of Sale (POS) machines. For all the other machines, Pin will need to be inputted

(Please note that in India, payment through contactless mode is allowed for a maximum of ₹5,000 for a single transaction without entering your Credit Card PIN. However, if the amount is higher than or equal to ₹5,000, the Card holder must enter the Credit Card PIN for security reasons. You may check for the Contactless Network Symbol on your card.)

Card Activation

  • HDFC Bank Credit Card holders must activate their Credit Cards within 30 days from the Card Open Date, as per ‘Master Direction – Credit and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022’ dated April 21, 2022, realised by Reserve Bank of India (RBI). In case the Credit Card is not activated within 30 days of the card opening date, a grace period of 7 days will be given to activate the card with the below-mentioned modes. At the end of the 37th day, the card will be closed.

Kindly refer to the FAQ to know the process of activating the card.

  • For all the cards issued on or post 1 st December, 2023: The joining fee on customer’s card is levied on 45th day from card issuance
  • Renewal Fee: The renewal fee for all the cardholders will be levied on 1 st month of the anniversary year.

  • Yes, customer can apply for the card but this card will be given as a floater card with a shared limit. To apply for Marriott Bonvoy HDFC Bank Credit Card, his credit limit for the card he already holds in HDFC Bank should be minimum 1L/ month. The card will be issued with a credit limit of Rs 5000 temporarily up to 5-7 working days, the limit of your existing HDFC Bank Credit Card will be updated on this new card as shared limit. A detailed communication will also be sent to explain how the shared limit will function.

  • Customer can apply through digital application form or can visit the nearest bank branch and apply by filling physical application form and floater declaration form.

  • Once the Marriott Bonvoy HDFC Bank Credit Card is approved, Membership Number will be generated within 10 working days. On successful Membership Number generation, cardmember will receive communication from Marriott on their registered Email ID within 72hours.
